```artifact
Feature: Patient Management and Workflow

  Scenario: Query on Patient Id and Modify Details
    Given a patient with ID "P001" and pin-code "1234"
    When I query for patient ID "P001"
    Then the patient details are displayed
    And I can modify the patient details
    And the patient pin-code cannot be modified to be outside the Zone

  Scenario: Query on Patient Id and Create Appointment
    Given a patient with ID "P002"
    When I query for patient ID "P002"
    Then the patient details are displayed
    And I enter details like Speciality, Symptoms, Consultation request, Appointment date
    Then an entry is created into the Patient Appointment file if the Appointment Request is for next day

  Scenario: Doctor Sees Consultation Requests
    Given a doctor
    When the doctor sees all the workflow consultation requests
    Then the doctor selects a consultation request one by one to provide Consultation

  Scenario: Doctor Enters Diagnosis and Prescribes Medicines
    Given a doctor
    When the doctor sees a Patient Consultation Request
    Then the doctor enters Diagnosis
    And the doctor prescribes medicines (max 8)
    And the doctor requests for lab tests (optional) max(5)

  Scenario: Chemist Sees Consultation Requests
    Given a chemist
    When the chemist sees all the workflow consultation requests
    Then the chemist selects a consultation request one by one to provide Medicines

  Scenario: Chemist Dispenses Medicines
    Given a chemist
    When the chemist sees a Prescription
    Then the chemist dispenses medicines
    And the chemist marks the flag in Prescription

  Scenario: Lab Sees Consultation Requests
    Given a lab
    When the lab sees all the workflow consultation requests
    Then the lab selects a consultation request one by one to note down the Lab Requests

  Scenario: Lab Notes Lab Tests and Adds Report
    Given a lab
    When the lab sees a Prescription
    Then the lab notes the lab tests to be done and the Patient details
    And the lab marks the flag in prescription
    And the lab adds the report
```
